newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS IN TIGHT RANGES, LACK MOMENTUM.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS IN TIGHT RANGES, LACK MOMENTUM.

text.p: 1420/1120 GMT - Bonds wriggle in tight ranges in early
afternoon trade with the market lacking fresh incentives and
some operators reluctant to take up new positions ahead of Fed's
FOMC meeting next Tuesday. Markka trades in 3.0130-3.0230 range
vs mark, and recovers above 0.67 vs crown in calm dealings.
*FIM-06 yld pct 6.07 vs 6.09 *06 gap over Bund bps 38 vs 37
*FIM-04 yld pct 5.64 vs 5.65 *FIM-99 yld pct 3.69 vs 3.70
*Jun FRAs 3.11 pct vs 3.12 *March FRAs 3.75 pct vs 3.79
